english.note: Use this when admitting that something is true or acknowledging a fact.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for admitting that a fact or belief is true.
Use 承認 when reluctantly acknowledging that something is true or conceding a point.

examples.english: I concede that this news is true.
examples.traditional: 我承認呢個消息係真嘅。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jing6 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hai6 zan1 ge3

examples.english: I acknowledge that I was wrong this time.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jing6 ni1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 co3

examples.english: I have to allow that you're right, but I still disagree.
examples.traditional: 我承認你講得啱，但係我仲係唔同意。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jing6 nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 daan6 hai6 ngo5 zung6 hai6 m4 tung4 ji3
